item.description:
### Added - **Link history.** Chowser keeps a local log of the links it handles: time, source app, and whether the link opened in a browser, opened in a native app, or was dismissed. It lives in **Settings → Activity** with All / Dismissed / Auto-routed filters, host search, and per-link Open, Open in…, Copy URL, and Create Rule. A 7-day summary shows link count, share auto-routed, dismissed links, and top apps and domains. - **Never lose a dismissed link.** If a script or coding agent runs `open https://…` and you click away from the picker, the link is still in Activity. `chowser://reopen` runs the last dismissed link through routing again. - **Recent links in the menu bar.** "Show Recent Links" lists the last 5 links with an outcome icon; hold ⌥ to create a rule for a host. "Show All…" opens Activity. "Reopen Last Link In" sends the last link to any browser; hold ⌥ to always open that host there (the rule goes to the top of your list so it wins). - **Activity level** in Settings → Privacy: Full history, Stats only (host only, no path or query), or Off. New installs start at Full history. If you're updating, Chowser starts at Stats only and shows a one-time "Turn On Link History…" tip, so no full links are saved until you choose. Lowering it asks first, then deletes data the new level doesn't allow. The local API has an `activityLevel` setting too. - **Delete several browsers or rules at once.** Cmd-click or Shift-click rows in Settings → Browsers or Rules, then remove them together. Chowser asks first, and one ⌘Z brings them all back in their original places.
### Changed - **The "Recent URLs" submenu is replaced** by Recent Links and Reopen Last Link In. Both appear only at Full history. - **Domain click counts respect the Off switch.** They used to have no off switch; Off now deletes them and stops counting. - **The picker ignores focus loss in its first 400 ms**, so a click that lands as it appears no longer dismisses it. It stays up without taking your typing; the next click elsewhere or Escape closes it. - **Reset to Fresh Setup also clears link history and click counts.** - History is stored in a private file (0600), holds at most 500 links for 30 days, skips private-mode opens, and is not part of Export All.

### Changed - **Settings is reorganised.** The sidebar is now Browsers, Rules, Rewrites, Native Apps, Picker, Privacy, General, and Backup & Advanced. - **Rewrites work like Rules.** Drag to reorder, edit in a side panel, undo deletes, and test a link from the toolbar. Catalog rewrites stay read-only; duplicate one to make an editable copy. - **Native Apps** shows one Allow switch per app, with the technical details behind info buttons. - **Privacy** has a single "Look up link details online" switch, plus short-link services, the timeout, and tracking cleanup. - **General** leads with whether Chowser is your default browser. "App mode" is now "Show in Dock". - **Backup & Advanced** collects Export All / Import, importing from the App Store version, the developer API, Set Up with AI, diagnostics, and reset. - The Appearance page is now called Picker; nothing on it changed.

### Changed - **Rules are a table you can reorder.** Rules are checked top to bottom and the first match wins; drag a rule to change its priority. "When no rule matches" now sits at the top of the Rules page. - **Edit rules in a side panel.** Problems show up next to the field as you type, and nothing you type is thrown away. "Test a Link" in the toolbar shows which rule a link would match. - **Browsers are a reorderable list.** Rename in place, pick shortcuts (choosing one that's taken swaps the two), and edit profiles and launch arguments in a side panel. Add several detected browsers at once. - **Undo deletes.** Removing a rule or a browser can be undone with Cmd-Z. - **Hidden apps** moved to the Browsers page. - The Settings window opens a little larger so the list and side panel fit side by side.

### Added - **Set Up with AI is one click away.** It's in the menu bar menu and on the Rules page in Settings: Chowser starts its local-only API, copies a setup prompt to your clipboard, and tells you where to paste it.
### Changed - **First launch is one screen.** Make Chowser your default browser or skip it. Your installed browsers and profiles are added automatically (your current default browser gets shortcut 1), and settings from the App Store version can be brought over in the same step. New installs start in menu bar mode. - **The menu bar menu leads with "Make Chowser Your Default Browser…"** until Chowser is the default. - **The picker no longer draws a box around the first browser** every time it opens. Selection appears as a soft highlight once you hover or use the arrow keys; Return still opens the first browser. - **A short shortcut hint** appears in the picker for the first few opens.
### Fixed - **The preview backdrop switcher in Settings → Appearance is no longer cut off.**

### Changed - **Faster to open.** In App mode, Settings appears about 0.3 s sooner, and a link that launches Chowser no longer pulls Settings over your browser. Clicking the Dock icon opens Settings faster too. - **The picker no longer jumps.** The link preview fills reserved space instead of growing the window a moment after it opens, and pressing P or R no longer resizes it.

### Added - **Import from the App Store version.** Moving to the direct download? Settings → General → Moving from the App Store copies your browsers, rules and rewrites from the App Store or TestFlight install on the same Mac. macOS may ask you to allow access to the other app's data.

### Added - **Open links in native apps.** Approved links can open directly in their native app (for example Spotify) using a signed, verified app directory. Each app needs your approval, and the registered handler is checked right before opening. - **Signed rewrite catalogs.** Predefined URL rewrites are now delivered as signed catalogs with an explicit review-and-install flow; they never overwrite your own rules. - **Direct-download builds are back.** Chowser is published again as a signed, notarized DMG on GitHub Releases, with Sparkle updates.
### Fixed - **Chromium profiles now apply when the browser is already running.** Links previously opened in whichever profile was used last. - **Browsers without profile or private-mode flags reuse the open window** instead of spawning a new window for every link (most visible in Safari).
